title: Android: (Stack Trace) Crash - RenderingDeviceDriverVulkan::compute_pipeline_create()
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.7.2.stable

### System information

Samsung a04, Android 14

### Issue description

We're seeing some crashes in Play Console on 2 specific Android devices so far.

Godot 4.7.2.stable, Mobile renderer.

Device 1: Samsung Galaxy A04 (samsung a04), Android 14 (SDK 34)
Device 2: Motorola moto g55 5G (motorola taipei), Android 16 (SDK 36)

I have **not** seen this on any of the devices I have available on my own (Samsung Galaxy S9+ and Google Pixel 9a)., and the vast majority of our user base has seemingly not seen/reported this either.


We have 2 different issues in Play Console, but I believe they might be the same issue given the function signature displayed, although different crash "type" (SIGSEGV vs SIGABRT):
* 2x stack traces for SIGSEGV - [split_config.arm64_v8a.apk!libgodot_android.so] rendering_device_driver_vulkan.cpp - RenderingDeviceDriverVulkan::compute_pipeline_create(RenderingDeviceDriver::ShaderID, VectorView<RenderingDeviceCommons::PipelineSpecializationConstant>)
* 1x stack trace for SIGABRT - [split_config.arm64_v8a.apk!libgodot_android.so] rendering_device_driver_vulkan.cpp - RenderingDeviceDriverVulkan::compute_pipeline_create(RenderingDeviceDriver::ShaderID, VectorView<RenderingDeviceCommons::PipelineSpecializationConstant>)
